Mermaid 11.12.0 browser runtime (MIT).

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mermaid@11.12.0/dist/mermaid.min.js

The upstream IIFE is kept intact, including bundled license notices. Its final global assignment is replaced by an ES module default export so the PRD renderer can load it on demand. The runtime is served locally and needs no remote rendering service.
